text: At its meeting on February 15, 2018, the Toronto Transit Commission Board considered a report, entitled "PricewaterhouseCoopers LLP 2016 Management Letter Follow-up Report”. The Board adopted the recommendations in the report, as follows: It is recommended that the Board: 1. Receive the report. 2. Approve forwarding a copy of the report to the City Clerk for appropriate handling. The foregoing is submitted to the City of Toronto Audit Committee for information.
The Audit Committee received this Item for information.
